picks.headline: Isomorphic Labs announces Series C investment round
picks.blurb: The AI drug-design company raised $5 billion, co-led by Greenoaks and Sequoia, to scale its proprietary drug design engine and therapeutic candidate pipeline.

picks.headline: Plasma proteomics identifies insulin resistance signatures predictive of cardiometabolic disease risk
picks.blurb: Blood protein profiling paired with clamp-based insulin sensitivity measurements yielded a tissue-resolved atlas and a model the authors report beats conventional markers for forecasting metabolic and heart disease.
